title: Do not use finish-session helper for this project by default
decision: Codex should not invoke the legacy finish-session helper for the senku-archivist workspace unless the user explicitly asks to publish, commit, push, or run finish-session. Normal Senku Archivist work should use project-brain validation, focused smoke evidence, and explicit user-directed git operations instead.
context: The finish-session helper is an older workspace-closing workflow and this repository does not contain the .agents/workspace-skills.json manifest it expects. Running it in senku-archivist creates noise and reports a blocked helper state even when the actual project work is healthy.
rationale: Senku Archivist already uses .project-brain, SG backlog evidence, npm smoke checks, and explicit commit/push choices as its operating model. Suppressing the old helper avoids confusing closeout chatter while preserving the ability to run it manually if the user asks.
alternatives_considered: Add .agents/workspace-skills.json to satisfy the old helper
Keep probing finish-session proactively after every dirty-tree pass
Remove finish-session from the global Codex install
consequences: Do not run /home/irovian/.codex/skills/finish-session/scripts/finish_session.py during routine senku-archivist work.
If the user asks to commit or push, use normal explicit git operations or a project-appropriate publication workflow.
If the user explicitly asks for finish-session by name, treat that as an override.
Continue reporting changed files and validation evidence in final responses when useful.
